about.story.p1: I tīmata tō mātou kōrero i tētahi rōpū kaitākaro Wplace i rongo pouri ai ki ngā taputapu pixel toi o nāianei. He uaua rānei, kāore rānei i whakataurite ki te kapa tae ōkawa, he whakararu rānei i te tūmatanui kaiwhakamahi.
about.story.p2: I whakatau mātou ki te waihanga i tētahi mea pai ake - he taputapu māmā hei whakamahi, tino tika, ā tino tūmataiti hoki. I muri i ngā marama whakawhanake me te whakamātau me te hapori ka whakarewa mātou i tā mātou tauhuri.

blog.article1.desc: Tīmata tō pixel toi tawhiti me tā mātou aratohu whānui. He mea katoa mai i ngā tukuake tuatahi ki ngā tikanga whakataurite kapa tae matatau me te whakapai, ako ai koe ki te tauhuri ngā whakaahua katoa ki te pixel toi Wplace whakaū kore uaua.
blog.article1.title: Te Tīmatanga: Tō Aratohu Taketake mō te Wplace Tool
blog.article2.desc: Whakanui i tō pixel toi me ngā tirohanga tohunga mō te ariā tae me te whakarite kapa. Kite ai i ngā rautaki ngaio hei whakatutuki i te whakataurite tae tino pai, waihanga whakaahua kanapu, ā me te mea kia tino kitea ai tō toi i runga i te kānata Wplace.
blog.article2.title: Mana i te Tae: Ngā Rautaki Kapa Matatau mō ngā Ringatoi Wplace
blog.article3.desc: Whakamarama i te whakarahi whakaahua me te whakamārama hohonu o ngā tikanga Nearest Neighbor, Bilinear, me Lanczos. Mārama ai ngā pānga taketake mō te pixel toi, me te whakaū koe ka kōwhiri i te tikanga pai rawa hei pupuri i te kounga me te whakatutuki i ngā hua koi.
blog.article3.title: Whakarahi Pixel Tika: He Kōrero Hohonu mō te Whakaahua Whakahōu
blog.article4.desc: Kite ai i te mana o te dithering mō ngā tawhiti tae māhaki ake me ngā mata rawa ake i tō pixel toi, tae ai ki a Floyd-Steinberg. Ako ai mēhea ai ēnei tikanga ka whakapai ai i ngā taipitopito, whakaheke ai i te banding, ā whakauru ai ki te taiao tawhito tūturu.
blog.article4.title: Whakapai Taipitopito: Te Toi me te Pūtaiao o te Dithering i te Pixel Toi
blog.beginner.advanced.desc: Kimi ai i ngā whiringa matatau hei whakahaere ake i tō pixel toi:
blog.beginner.advanced.dithering: Whakahohonu Floyd-Steinberg Dithering: Kā āwhina ēnei tikanga ki te whakamāhaki i ngā tawhiti tae me te whakaheke i te banding, rawa rawa ai mō ngā whakaahua me ngā kapa tae iti.
blog.beginner.advanced.grid: Whakaatu Pixel Grid: Ka whakairi i tētahi mata i runga i tō arokite hei kite i ngā pixel takitahi, he āwhina mō te whakanoho tika i runga i te kānata Wplace.
blog.beginner.advanced.scaling: Tikanga Whakarahi Whakaahua: Kōwhiri i waenganui i a Nearest Neighbor (koi rawa, poraka), Bilinear (māhaki ake, ā-kore nei), me Lanczos (kounga teitei, pai mō te whakaheke).
blog.beginner.advanced.title: 3. Whiringa Matatau (kōwhiringa)
blog.beginner.closing: Nā kua mōhio koe ki ngā taketake o te Wplace Paint Tool, kua rite te taima ki te tīmata waihanga i tō ake pixel toi! Tukuake tō whakaahua tuatahi, whakarite ngā whiringa ā whakamīharo ai ki ngā hua. I a koe e tipu nei, ka āhei koe ki te whakamātau ki ngā whakaahua me ngā tikanga uaua ake. Koa waihanga i a Wplace!
blog.beginner.download.desc: I a koe e mānu ai ki tō pixel toi, ka āhei koe ki te tango tōtika mai i te taiao arokite. Ka whai kōwhiringa koe ki te tango me te pixel grid rānei kāore rānei i runga i ō hiahia whakanoho i runga i te kānata Wplace.
blog.beginner.download.title: 5. Tango tō Pixel Toi
blog.beginner.intro: Nau mai ki te Wplace Paint Tool! Mā tēnei aratohu koe e ārahi ai i ngā mea katoa me mōhio ai koe ki te tauhuri i ō whakaahua ki te pixel toi whakamīharo mō te kānata Wplace. Ahakoa he ringatoi pixel wheako koe, he tamariki rānei koe, kā mea ā mātou taputapu kia māmā, kia koa hoki.
blog.beginner.palette.desc: Kā tauhuri aunoa ā mātou taputapu i tō whakaahua ki te kapa tae ōkawa 64-tae Wplace, whakaū ai i te whakataurite tika ki te papaaho. Kā whakaatu te taiao arokite pēhea ai tō toi i runga i te kānata, me te whakaatu hoki o ngā tae i whakamahia.
blog.beginner.palette.title: 4. Mārama ki te Kapa Tae Wplace
blog.beginner.pixel_size.desc: Ko te nekehanga rahi pixel tō taiao whakahaere matua hei whakarite i te rōpū taipitopito i tō pixel toi. He iti ake te rahi pixel he maha ake ngā taipitopito me te whakaahua rahi ake, ā he rahi ake te rahi pixel kā waihanga i tētahi mata kē ake, poraka.
blog.beginner.pixel_size.experiment: Whakamātau ki ngā uara rerekē hei kimi i te taurite tika mō tō toi.
blog.beginner.pixel_size.large: Rahi Pixel Rahi Ake: Kē ake, poto ake te putanga.
blog.beginner.pixel_size.small: Rahi Pixel Iti Ake: He maha ake ngā taipitopito, rahi ake te putanga.
blog.beginner.pixel_size.title: 2. Whakatikatika Rahi Pixel
blog.beginner.tips.community: Uru ki te hapori Wplace mō ētahi atu tohutohu me te whakaahua!
blog.beginner.tips.experiment: Whakamātau ki ngā rahi pixel rerekē me ngā whiringa dithering.
blog.beginner.tips.grid: Whakamahi i te pixel grid mō te whakanoho tika i a Wplace.

blog.beginner.troubleshooting.connection: Raruraru Hononga: Mēnā kāore te taputapu e whakautu ana, tirohia tō hononga ipurangi ā whakahōu te whārangi.
blog.beginner.troubleshooting.desc: Mēnā ka pā mai ngā raruraru, whakamātau ēnei:
blog.beginner.troubleshooting.format: Hē Hōputu Kōnae: Whakaū kei te hōputu tautokohia tō whakaahua (PNG, JPG, JPEG).
blog.beginner.troubleshooting.processing: Roa Tukatuka: He roa ake te taima tukatuka mō ngā whakaahua rahi ake, mānu rānei whakamātau rānei i tētahi whakaahua iti ake.
blog.beginner.troubleshooting.title: Whakatika Raruraru
blog.beginner.upload.desc: Hei tīmata, tōia ā whakataka rānei tō whakaahua ki te taiao tukuake kua whakaritea, kōwhiri rānei i tētahi kōnae mai i tō taputapu. Kā tautoko mātou i ngā hōputu PNG, JPG, me JPEG. Mō ngā hua pai rawa whakamahi i tētahi whakaahua puna kounga teitei.
blog.beginner.upload.size: Rahi Mōrahi: Ahakoa kā tukatuka ā mātou taputapu i ngā rahi rerekē, he roa pea te tukatuka o ngā whakaahua rahi ake.

blog.dithering.balancing.desc: Ko te kī o te dithering whaihua ko te kimi i te taurite tika. He maha rawa te dithering ka kitea ai he hauhunga te whakaahua, he iti rawa ka hua ai ngā pae tae mārō. He nui te whakamātau e hiahiatia ana ki te whakatutuki i te taiao hiahiatia mō tō pixel toi Wplace.
blog.dithering.balancing.title: Whakataurite Taipitopito me te Atahua
blog.dithering.closing: Mana i te dithering hei tāpiri hohonu me te taonga ki tō pixel toi Wplace!
blog.dithering.floyd_steinberg.applicati: Whakamahi: Kā whakarato tā mātou taputapu Wplace Paint Tool i te kōwhiringa hei whakahohonu i a Floyd-Steinberg dithering mō te whakaranu tae matatau.
blog.dithering.floyd_steinberg.benefits: Ngā Painga: Kā whakaputa i ngā hua tika me te banding iti, pai rawa mō te whakatutuki i ngā tawhiti māhaki me ngā kapa iti.
blog.dithering.floyd_steinberg.desc: Ko a Floyd-Steinberg tētahi o ngā hātepe dithering rongonui, whaihua hoki. Kā mahi mā te kōkuhu i te hē quantization o ia pixel ki ōna hoa tata, waihanga ai i tētahi ira māhaki, taiao.
blog.dithering.floyd_steinberg.how_it_wo: Pēhea ai e Mahi ana: Kā tiritiria te hē ki ngā pixel matau, hauī-mauī, hauī, me matau-hauī.
blog.dithering.floyd_steinberg.title: Floyd-Steinberg Dithering
blog.dithering.intro: Ko te dithering he tikanga kaha i te pixel toi e whakāhei ana koe ki te waihanga i te mata o ngā tae maha ake me ngā ira māhaki ake i tā tō kapa iti nei i whakarato ai. Kā tirotiro tēnei aratohu i te toi me te pūtaiao o te dithering, aro ai ki tana whakamahi ki te pixel toi Wplace.
blog.dithering.other_techniques.desc: Ahakoa he rongonui a Floyd-Steinberg, he tikanga kē hoki:
blog.dithering.other_techniques.ordered: Dithering Rārangi: Whakamahi i tētahi tauira mutu hei whakarite hea ai ngā pixel. Ka āhei te waihanga i tētahi mata whakaahua, mata.
blog.dithering.other_techniques.random: Dithering Tūpono: He tāpiri noa i te hauhunga tūpono. He iti te whaihua mō te whakamāhaki i ngā ira engari ka āhei te whakamahi mō ētahi taiao toi motuhake.
blog.dithering.other_techniques.title: Ētahi atu Tikanga Dithering
blog.dithering.tips.consider_palette: Whakaarohia te Kapa: He whaihua rawa te dithering i a koe e mahi nei me ngā kapa tae iti rawa.
blog.dithering.tips.preview: Arokite Tawhito: Tirohia tō whakaahua dithering kua whakamahia i te arokite Wplace Paint Tool kia whakaū ai kei te whakatutuki i ō tūmanakohanga.
blog.dithering.tips.subtle: Ko te Māhaki te Kī: I te nuinga o te taima, he whaihua ake te whakamahi māhaki o te dithering i te kaikino.
blog.dithering.tips.title: Tohutohu Whakamahi Dithering
blog.dithering.title: Whakapai Taipitopito: Te Toi me te Pūtaiao o te Dithering i te Pixel Toi
blog.dithering.what_is.desc: Ko te dithering te whakamahi hauhunga whakakino hei whakakē i te hē quantization, ārai ai i ngā tauira rahi pērā i te tae banding. I te pixel toi, ka whakamahia hei whakarite i ngā tae kāore i te kapa mā te whakanoho rautaki i ngā pixel o ngā tae o te kapa.
blog.dithering.what_is.title: He Aha te Dithering?
blog.palette.advanced.desc: I tua atu i te kōwhiri tae noa, whakaarohia ēnei tikanga matatau:
blog.palette.advanced.hue_shifting: Nekehanga Tae: Engari i te whakamea, whakamā rānei noa i tētahi tae, nekehia māhaki tana tae i a ia e kōpikopiko ana mai i te mārama ki te atarangi. Kā tāpiri tēnei i te kanapu me te tūturu.
blog.palette.advanced.limited: Ngā Kapa Iti: Wero koe ki te waihanga toi whakakapi me tētahi huinga tae iti rawa. Kā wero tēnei i te auahatanga ā whakakaha ai i tō māramatanga o ngā uara tae.
blog.palette.advanced.ramps: Ngā Ara Tae: Waihanga tawhiti māhaki i waenganui i ngā tae mō te atarangi me ngā whakaatu. Ahakoa he kapa iti, he ara whaihua ka āhei te tāpiri hohonu nui.
blog.palette.advanced.title: 2. Ngā Tikanga Kōwhiri Tae Matatau
blog.palette.closing: Whakatūwhera te mana o te tae i ō waihanga Wplace!
blog.palette.customizing.contextual: Whakamahi Horopaki: Ka āhei te kitea rerekē o tētahi tae i runga i ngā tae karapoti. Whakamahi tēnei mata atahua hei painga mōu.
blog.palette.customizing.desc: Ahakoa he mutu te kapa Wplace, ka āhei koe te whakarite i tō huarahi:
blog.palette.customizing.precomputation: Rorohiko Mua: Whakamahi ngā taputapu waho, ō whakamātau rānei me te Wplace Paint Tool hei whakarite i mua ai ngā tae Wplace pai rawa hei whakaatu i ngā tae hiahiatia.
blog.palette.customizing.title: 3. Whakarite me te Whakataurite Kapa
blog.palette.harmony.analogous: Ngā Tae Rite: Ngā tae tata i te taiawhio tae ka waihanga i te mārie me te kotahitanga.
blog.palette.harmony.complementary: Ngā Tae Whakakapi: Ngā tae kē ka waihanga rerekētanga kaha me te koa mata.
blog.palette.harmony.desc: Kāore te ritenga tae he mea atahua anake; he mea whakawhiti kare-ā-roto me te ārahi mata kaitirotiro:
blog.palette.harmony.monochromatic: Ngā Kaupapa Tae Kotahi: Te whakamahi i ngā tae rerekē me ngā mata o tētahi tae ka āhei te waihanga i tētahi toi atahua, ritenga.
blog.palette.harmony.title: 4. Ritenga Tae me te Whakatutuki Kare-ā-roto
blog.palette.intro: I te pixel toi ko te kapa tae te tūāpapa o tō toi. He kapa pai kua kōwhiria ka mea kia ritenga, kanapu, ā atahua mata ai tō toi, ā he kapa kino kua kōwhiria ka kitea ai te mahi pixel pai rawa hoki he tamariki.
blog.palette.tips.less_is_more: He Iti he Nui: I te nuinga o te taima, he whaihua ake tētahi kapa iti pai kua kōwhiria i tētahi whānui.
blog.palette.tips.study_masters: Ako i ngā Tohunga: Tātari i ngā kōwhiringa tae o ngā ringatoi pixel rongonui hei whakaahua me te ako.
blog.palette.tips.test_canvas: Whakamātau i te Kānata: Arokite mutunga kore tō pixel toi i runga i te kānata Wplace hei kite pēhea ai ngā tae i te taiao tūturu.
blog.palette.tips.title: Tohutohu Whakamahi Tae Whaihua
blog.palette.title: Ngā Rautaki Kapa Tae mō te Pixel Toi: Mana i te Tūāpapa o tō Toi
blog.palette.understanding.desc: He kapa tae he huinga tae iti ka whakamahia mutunga kore i tō toi katoa. Ngā here ka whakangao i te auahatanga ā te mahi me tētahi kapa iti ka wero koe kia atahua ake ō kōwhiringa tae.
blog.palette.understanding.premium: Tae Kore Utu vs Premium: Wehea ngā tae tūmatanui me ngā premium hei whakamahere pai i ō hoahoa.
blog.palette.understanding.relationships: Ngā Hononga Tae: Mātakitaki pēhea ai ngā tae e taunekeneke ana i roto i te kapa hei waihanga rerekētanga, hohonu, me te kare-ā-roto.
blog.palette.understanding.title: Mārama ki ngā Taketake Kapa Tae
blog.resampling.bilinear.cons: Ngā Kino: Kā whakakino, whakangaro i te koi pixel, kāore e tūtohua mō te whakarahi pixel toi.
blog.resampling.bilinear.desc: Ko te interpolation bilinear ka whakaarohia ngā pixel whā tata rawa hei whakarite i te tae pixel hou. Kā hua ai tētahi putanga māhaki ake, iti ake te pixelated engari ka āhei te kawe mai i te kino kāore e hiahiatia mō te pixel toi.
blog.resampling.bilinear.pros: Ngā Painga: Ngā tawhiti māhaki ake, ngā mata iti ake te kaikino.
blog.resampling.bilinear.title: 2. Interpolation Bilinear (māhaki ake, engari kino)
blog.resampling.bilinear.when_to_use: Hea ai e Whakamahi ai: Kāore he maha mō te pixel toi. Pai ake mō ngā whakaahua whakaahua.
blog.resampling.choosing.desc: Mō te pixel toi Wplace Nearest Neighbor he tino tūtohu i ngā rā katoa te tikanga whakarahi. Kā whakaū kia noho koi, kitea ai ō pixel, pupuri ai i te atahua hiahiatia. Kā whakarato tā mātou taputapu Wplace Paint Tool i a Nearest Neighbor hei kōwhiringa matua nā tēnei take.
blog.resampling.choosing.title: Kōwhiri i te Tikanga Tika mō Wplace
blog.resampling.closing: Mana i tō whakarahi mō ngā waihanga Wplace pixel tika!
blog.resampling.intro: Ko te whakarahi whakaahua he taonga taketake o te pixel toi, rawa rawa ai i a koe e whakarite nei i ō waihanga mō ngā papaaho pērā i a Wplace. Kā whakamarama tēnei aratohu i ngā tikanga whakahōu rerekē ā āwhina ai koe ki te kōwhiri i te pai rawa hei pupuri i te taketake me te koi o tō pixel toi.
blog.resampling.lanczos.cons: Ngā Kino: Ka āhei hoki te whakamāhaki i te pixel toi, he uaua ake te rorohiko.
blog.resampling.lanczos.desc: Ko a Lanczos he hātepe whakahōu uaua ake ka whakaputa hua kounga teitei rawa rawa mō te whakaheke whakaahua whakaahua. Whakamahi i te mahinga sinc hei tatau i ngā uara pixel hou, hua ai ngā hua koi ake i a bilinear engari ka kawe tonu mai i ētahi interpolation ka āhei te whakamāhaki i te pixel toi.
blog.resampling.lanczos.pros: Ngā Painga: Pai mō te whakaheke whakaahua whakaahua, koi ake i a bilinear.
blog.resampling.lanczos.title: 3. Lanczos Resampling (kounga teitei, engari uaua)
blog.resampling.lanczos.when_to_use: Hea ai e Whakamahi ai: Kāore he maha mō te pixel toi, ki te hiahia whakamāhaki iti, ngā taiao whakaheke motuhake rānei.
blog.resampling.nearest.cons: Ngā Kino: Ka āhei te waihanga raina kaikino me ngā taiao "arawhata" rawa rawa i te whakaheke, mēnā kāore e whakamahi tika.
blog.resampling.nearest.desc: Ko a Nearest Neighbor te tikanga māmā rawa, ā he mea hiahia hoki mō te pixel toi. Kā mahi mā te kape, whakakore rānei noa i ngā pixel kāore he interpolation. Kā hua ai ngā mata koi, poraka ā pupuri ai i te mata pixelated kitea.
blog.resampling.nearest.pros: Ngā Painga: Pupuri i te koi pixel, kāore he kino, pai mō te whakarahi pixel toi.
blog.resampling.nearest.title: 1. Nearest Neighbor (te hiahia o te ringatoi pixel)
blog.resampling.nearest.when_to_use: Hea ai e Whakamahi ai: I ngā wā katoa mō te whakarahi pixel toi. He maha hoki mō te whakaheke mēnā he matua te pupuri mata koi.
blog.resampling.title: Whakarahi Pixel Tika: He Kōrero Hohonu mō te Whakaahua Whakahōu
blog.resampling.understanding.desc: Ko te whakahōu te tahuhu o te tawhiti whakarahi whakaahua. I a koe e whakarahi nei i tētahi whakaahua pixel toi, ka tāpiritia, tangohia rānei ngā pixel hou. Ko te tikanga whakamahi mō tēnei tahuhu ka whakarereke nui i te mata mutunga o tō toi.
blog.resampling.understanding.title: Mārama ki te Whakaahua Whakahōu
blog.subtitle: Whakatūwhera tō taiao auaha i runga i te kānata Wplace. Ko tā mātou blog tō rauemi hei mana ai i ngā tikanga pixel toi, whakapai ai i ō pūkenga peita Wplace, ā whakamahi pai ai i ā mātou taputapu kaha mā ngā aratohu hohonu me ngā akoranga whakaahua.

brand.name: Wplace Paint Tool
faq.a1: Ko te tauhuri pixel toi Wplace he tauhuri pixel toi kore utu ipurangi ka tauhuri i ngā whakaahua katoa ki te pixel toi atahua. Kā whakamahi tā mātou taputapu Wplace i te whakataurite tae matatau mō ngā hua whakamīharo.
faq.a2: Āe! Ko te tauhuri pixel toi Wplace he kore utu katoa 100%. Waihanga ngā pixel toi maha ai koe e hiahia ai.
faq.a3: Kā tautoko te tauhuri pixel toi Wplace i ngā hōputu PNG, JPG, JPEG, me SVG. Tukuake ngā whakaahua katoa ā tauhuri tonu.
FAQ.a4: Kāo! Kē ai i ētahi atu taputapu, kāore he taupā rahi whakaahua o te tauhuri pixel toi Wplace. Tukatuka ngā whakaahua rahi katoa me tā mātou taputapu Wplace kaha.
faq.a5: Āe rawa! Kā tukatuka te tauhuri pixel toi Wplace i ngā mea katoa i tō pūtirotiro taiao. Kāore ō whakaahua e wehe atu i tō taputapu, whakarato ai i te tūmatanui katoa.
